title: Model landscape scoreboard and sprint-ready intel pack
creator: Ava Patel
description: Purpose: create a lightweight, operational 'scoreboard' for the open-model landscape that is sprint-ready for engineering, sales, and SRE stakeholders. The scoreboard will synthesize model availability, latency risk, fallback cost, quantization compatibility, and procurement friction into a single weekly digest and an exportable intelligence pack for upcoming sprints. This ticket covers schema design, data-source mapping, prototype ingestion pipeline, initial UI spec for a compact dashboard card, and a templated intel pack (one-pager + recommended prioritization actions) to hand to squads during planning.
acceptance_criteria: Scoreboard schema defined with at least 6 columns: model, region availability, median inference latency (50/95/99), fallback-cost multiplier, quantization-compatibility tier, procurement friction score

Prototype ingestion pipeline pulls weekly telemetry from: public model catalog, internal runtime telemetry (latency by region/model), and procurement signals (vendor status), and consolidates into a CSV + JSONL snapshot
Dashboard card spec created (Figma) that fits inside Console model catalogue page and a standalone weekly digest template for PM/Sales
First 'sprint-ready intel pack' produced for top 8 models used by Redwood customers with prioritized recommended actions and confidence annotations
Automation: scoreboard snapshot generation scheduled weekly (cron) and stored in shared Drive; alerting rule created for any model with >20% increase in 95th percentile latency week-over-week
tasks: Draft scoreboard schema and metric definitions (PM)
Map telemetry sources and required joins (PM + Eng data partner)
Implement prototype ingestion job (Eng, 2 days) - output CSV/JSONL
Design compact dashboard card and digest template (Design)
Run 2-week pilot on historical data to tune thresholds and confidence buckets (PM + Research)
Create templated intel pack generator (export script) and store in Drive, link to sales playbook
